beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju is puzzled looking at Kesar Paints, as its daily price range has narrowed dramatically over two weeks.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji explains that this is not dead price action, but a coiled spring accumulating energy inside a triangle.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju asks when and in which direction this coiled move will release, and how to trade it.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: After rallying from 400 to 500, Kesar Paints tightens between a lower high of 480 and a higher low of 440.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: As price oscillates toward the apex, daily trading volume dries up to barely half its average.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: At precisely the two-thirds apex distance, surging volume punctures resistance, driving price to ₹148.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: According to Murphy, triangles are classic continuation patterns representing pauses in major trends.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The vital timing rule demands price breaks out between two-thirds and three-quarters of the pattern's length.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: We will master vertical projection formulas and unpack the high-volatility broadening megaphone trap.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: A Symmetrical Triangle features a descending upper line and an ascending lower line converging to an apex.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Volume must steadily contract during formation, followed by a decisive volume explosion on breakout.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crucially, until a decisive closing penetration occurs, the symmetrical triangle remains directional agnostic.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The total horizontal span from the base start to the apex point defines the pattern's time horizon.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Murphy dictates that the most potent, reliable breakouts strike between the 2/3 and 3/4 time marks.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: If price meanders past the 3/4 mark into the apex, the pattern loses energy and drifts aimlessly.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In an Ascending Triangle, an identical horizontal roof caps rallies, while buyers aggressively push higher lows.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sellers unload at ₹500, but eager buyers scoop dips at ever-higher levels: ₹460, ₹475, ₹490.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Once all overhead supply is fully absorbed, price violently punches through the ceiling on heavy volume.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In a Descending Triangle, price tests a flat horizontal floor while sellers press relentless lower highs.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Buyers defend ₹420, but bounces weaken steadily: ₹460, then ₹445, then ₹430.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Finally, the floor collapses and price breaks decisively downward into a steep downtrend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The primary measuring technique measures the vertical height of the pattern's widest base.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: If breakout triggers at ₹148, adding the ₹98 base height yields a minimum target of ₹148.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Technique 2 draws a line parallel to the lower trendline originating from the first rally peak.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In a Broadening or Megaphone formation, boundary trendlines diverge outward instead of converging.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Unlike quiet contracting triangles, megaphone volume surges wildly on each widening swing.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: This heralds end-of-bull-market frenzy and emotional excess, usually resolving into a severe bear market.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Now it's your turn to evaluate this technical setup against Murphy's triangle rules.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Think carefully about what happens to a coiled spring when held too close to the apex.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Suspect a false or weak 'dud' breakout: Murphy states breakouts occurring past the 3/4 mark lack dynamic momentum and are prone to whipsaws.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju now understands that narrowing ranges represent explosive energy gathering, not boring lethargy.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji emphasizes that verifying volume on the breakout and respecting the 2/3 time window are non-negotiable.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju resolves to avoid emotional megaphones and calculate clear targets using the vertical base measurement.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Today's thread: triangles are the preeminent continuation vehicles for coiling market momentum.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: While symmetrical triangles remain neutral, ascending triangles carry bullish and descending bearish biases.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Always enforce the 2/3 to 3/4 apex rule; breaks that drag all the way to the corner lack true momentum.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crucial rule: Ascending Triangle: Flat upper horizontal resistance + rising lower trendline = Bullish bias; Descending Triangle: Flat lower horizontal support + falling upper trendline = Bearish bias.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crucial rule: Measuring Techniques: Project the vertical base height from breakout point or use parallel channels; Broadening Formation: Diverging trendlines with expanding volume signal dangerous, uncontrolled tops.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The ultimate takeaway: watch for volume dry-up inside the coil and execute decisively on time-validated breakouts.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

summarySteps: Triangles are continuation patterns: they reflect pauses before the primary trend resumes
Symmetrical Triangle: Converging upper and lower trendlines requiring minimum 4 contact points
The Apex Time Rule: Decisive breakouts must occur between 2/3 and 3/4 distance to the apex
Volume Behavior: Volume steadily contracts inside the coil and MUST surge on an upward breakout
Ascending Triangle: Flat upper horizontal resistance + rising lower trendline = Bullish bias
Descending Triangle: Flat lower horizontal support + falling upper trendline = Bearish bias
Measuring Techniques: Project the vertical base height from breakout point or use parallel channels
Broadening Formation: Diverging trendlines with expanding volume signal dangerous, uncontrolled tops
bottomTakeaway: Discipline and grounded market understanding are essential for survival.
